overview_description.description: TiDB powered by PingCAP (the company) is the distributed SQL database built for AI agents. AI-native companies, leading SaaS providers, and global enterprises run TiDB to support workloads that traditional databases cannot, including millions of tables, persistent agent state, high-concurrency reads and writes, frequent schema changes, and zero-downtime scaling at petabyte scale. With AI-driven innovations across the platform and multi-cloud flexibility, TiDB delivers the resilience, performance, and security organizations need for modern applications. Headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, TiDB serves customers worldwide. Learn more at TiDB.io.
